problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+2y+z=0 \\ x+3y+z=-1 \\ 2x-3y-z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

The system above has the matrix representation $Ax=b.$ Given that $x=⟨x,y,z⟩$ is unique, what is the value of $\frac{yz}{x}?$ 

*Hint: The inverse of the coefficient matrix is given by*

$$
\,{A}^{-1}=-\frac{1}{3}[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & -3 & 0 \\ -9 & 7 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
